name: MCP Office
description: Local-first MCP servers for Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word). Governed tool calls over Excel, PowerPoint, and Word via Python stdio. Requires Windows + Microsoft Office. No hosted tier — runs on your machine.

excelmcp.description: Excel MCP server — 60+ tools for reading, writing, formatting, and exporting Excel workbooks

environmentVariables.name: EXCEL_ALLOWLIST_ROOTS

environmentVariables.name: EXCEL_ENABLE_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to enable write operations
